reason: The Milan half is fully entailed and separately cited: Article 72(1) 'deemed "entered" into the Settlement System ... from the moment the validation time in T2S ends (SF1)', 72(2) 'cannot be revoked by a participant or a third party from the time of their matching in T2S (SF2), without prejudice to the bilateral cancellation of settlement Instructions provided for under Article 70 (2)', 72(3) 'final from the time of the debiting of the cash, or of the securities when settlement by cash is not provided for. (SF3)', with the Italian-prevails translation qualification, both LIMITATION lines and the 13 September (Milan) versus 14 September (EU) review dates kept apart, so the must-not condition is not triggered. The SFD half is also correct — Article 3(3) 'The moment of entry of a transfer order into a system shall be defined by the rules of that system' and Article 5 'from the moment defined by the rules of that system' — but the CSDR-side obligation (Article 39) is absent from the bundle and, rather than naming that gap, the answer affirmatively claims 'CSDR does not redefine these moments' from an Article 2 definitions excerpt that cannot support it; that unsupported legal claim (dimension 6 = 1) and the unnamed gap (dimension 5 = 1) make the case partial.
